topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walk through the garden, the ground soft and familiar under my feet, every step a whisper of memories entwined with the roots and the soil. There, in the heart of the plot where once a sapling stood, a young tree that I cradled and nurtured, now lies only a rough circle of earth. The air seems lighter, yet the space feels emptier too. But I remember the laughter that danced around it, the way it swayed gently, offering its shade as a quiet sanctuary. Even now, the spot feels like a home to the stories we’ve shared, and in my mind, the tree stands tall, its leaves whispering tales of growth and time. I bend down, my hands brushing the soil, and I plant a seed—a promise to the earth, to the past, and to all that will come.
